info.name: FSM Go Backend API
info.description:
Field Service Management API.

**Stack**: PostgreSQL 16 + PostGIS 3.5 + Go Backend (Gin) + GLAuth + Traefik
**Mode**: Single-tenant, JWT auth via Go Backend → direct PostgreSQL

## Quick Start
1. Select environment: FSM-dev
2. Run "Auth: Login" folder
3. Start querying endpoints

## Auth
POST /auth/login with employee_number + password to get JWT.
Token is cached in jwt_token variable and auto-refreshed on expiry.

**JWT payload**: {sub: employee_number, role: "admin|operator|technician"}
